pages.text: The seal carries the same faint warmth as the journal clasp. Whatever was stored here was meant to travel.
pages.title: Sealed cargo
Something to bring home
pages.text: A recovery mission issues its artifact at the named checkpoint. Keep it safe and hold it when using the extraction marker.

pages.title: Something to bring home
pages.text: The seal belongs to this expedition. A souvenir from another run cannot satisfy it.

pages.title: Proof has weight
pages.text: A recovered artifact is a physical item. Losing it can leave a required recovery unfinished. Return and retrieve it before extracting.

pages.title: Proof has weight
pages.text: At successful extraction, the bound cargo is consumed and its objective settles. The journal is a record; it does not stand in for the missing object.

pages.title: Proof has weight
pages.text: The frontier has a habit of making paperwork literal.
